scenario.summary: Guest, on the PDP opened by the head method: selects the fourth variant of the chain by its attribute values and, one after another, selects in the dropdown the three add-ons, adding the variant to the cart after each (three cart lines).
steps: Select variant4's Bulb Size, Color and Technology
Select add-on 1, add to cart, verify cart count
Select add-on 2, add to cart, verify cart count
Select add-on 3, add to cart, verify cart count
stateChanges: Guest cart: three lines of variant4 added; emptied by addOnTypeDropdownRemoveAllItemsFromCart
assertions: Cart count increases by one after each add
evidence: Class chain, first method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): addOnTypeDropdownSearchForConfigurableProduct runs first and declares every record need of the chain (product, variant1, variant2, variant3, variant4, addOn1, addOn2, addOn3); the migrated class keeps the resolved records in class fields and the later methods read them (SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when a field is null), so they declare no needs of their own. This method reads variant4 and addOn1..addOn3 (SKUs) and product.addOnGroupName (class fields). The record values it reads today (variant SKU z-2510011, add-on values) are declared as sources of addOnTypeDropdownSearchForConfigurableProduct; until the class is migrated, check-hardcoded reports them here.
selectAddonsDropDownBox clicks the option whose value is the add-on SKU (addOn1..addOn3.addOnSku).
Each add checks the cart count with the page object's counter; InitialQuantity '1' is config.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart/quickOrder entries and the Playwright pdp entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-06) and the approved Playwright pdp entries where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays, image extension) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
